#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Smoke test for POST /v1/trust/presentations/consumptions/manifest/verify-batch."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/mnt/e/SO/task04/solverA/task048")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from vcbackend import crypto  # noqa: E402

BASE_PATH = "/v1/trust/presentations/consumptions"
BATCH_PATH = BASE_PATH + "/manifest/verify-batch"


def _http(method, url, payload=None, headers=None, raw_body=None):
    data = raw_body if raw_body is not None else (
        json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    for k, v in (headers or {}).items():
        req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            return resp.status, resp.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        return exc.code, exc.read()


def wait_up(port, timeout=10.0):
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            _http("GET", f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health")
            return True
        except OSError:
            time.sleep(0.15)
    return False


def main():
    port = 9048
    store = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".json")
    env = dict(os.environ, VCBACKEND_STORE=store)

    def start():
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "vcbackend.cli", "serve",
             "--port", str(port), "--host", "127.0.0.1"],
            cwd=ROOT, env=env,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        assert wait_up(port), "服务启动超时"
        return proc

    proc = start()
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    failures = []

    def check(name, cond):
        print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), name)
        if not cond:
            failures.append(name)

    TA = {"X-Tenant-ID": "tenant-a"}
    TB = {"X-Tenant-ID": "tenant-b"}

    try:
        # 准备：签发者锚点 + 本地签名 DID + 签名 DID 的 vp 锚点
        issuer_priv, issuer_pub = crypto.generate_keypair() if hasattr(
            crypto, "generate_keypair") else (None, None)
        if issuer_priv is None:
            from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
            from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec

            def _keypair():
                priv = ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
                priv_pem = priv.private_bytes(
                    encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM,
                    format=serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,
                    encryption_algorithm=serialization.NoEncryption(),
                ).decode()
                pub_pem = priv.public_key().public_bytes(
                    encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM,
                    format=serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo,
                ).decode()
                return priv_pem, pub_pem
        else:
            raise SystemExit("unexpected")

        issuer_priv, issuer_pub = _keypair()
        issuer_did = "did:web:batch-issuer.example"
        st, _ = _http("POST", f"{base}/v1/trust/anchors",
                      {"did": issuer_did, "public_key": issuer_pub,
                       "key_version": 1}, TA)
        assert st == 201, st

        st, raw = _http("POST", f"{base}/v1/dids",
                        {"method": "web", "public_key": "batch-signer"}, TA)
        assert st in (200, 201), raw
        signer = json.loads(raw)
        signer_did, signer_pub = signer["did"], signer["public_key"]

        st, _ = _http("POST", f"{base}/v1/trust/anchors",
                      {"did": signer_did, "public_key": signer_pub,
                       "key_version": 1}, TA)
        assert st in (200, 201)

        def make_req(pid):
            p = {
                "presentation_id": pid,
                "credential_id": "vc_batch_0001",
                "issuer_did": issuer_did,
                "issuer_key_version": 1,
                "disclose": ["/role"],
                "claims": {"role": "管理员"},
                "challenge": "chal-批",
                "expires_at": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            }
            p = dict(p, proof=crypto.sign(p, issuer_priv))
            return {"presentation": p, "challenge": "chal-批"}

        for pid in ("批演示-1", "批演示-2"):
            st, raw = _http("POST", f"{base}/v1/trust/presentations/consume",
                            make_req(pid), TA)
            assert st in (200, 201), (pid, st, raw)

        st, ndjson_b = _http(
            "GET", f"{base}{BASE_PATH}/export?snapshot=2", headers=TA)
        assert st == 200, st
        ndjson_text = ndjson_b.decode()

        st, raw = _http(
            "GET",
            f"{base}{BASE_PATH}/manifest?snapshot=2&signer_did={signer_did}",
            headers=TA)
        assert st == 200, raw
        manifest = json.loads(raw)

        def batch(payload=None, raw_body=None, headers=TA):
            return _http("POST", base + BATCH_PATH, payload,
                         headers=headers, raw_body=raw_body)

        INVALID = {"results": [], "reason": "请求非法"}

        def expect_invalid(name, **kw):
            st, raw = batch(**kw)
            try:
                r = json.loads(raw.decode() or "{}")
            except ValueError:
                r = {}
            check(f"请求非法 200: {name}",
                  st == 200 and r == INVALID
                  and list(r.keys()) == ["results", "reason"])

        # ---- 请求级非法 ----
        expect_invalid("空体", raw_body=b"")
        expect_invalid("非法 JSON", raw_body=b"{not json")
        expect_invalid("非对象(数组)", raw_body=b"[1]")
        expect_invalid("非对象(字符串)", payload="x")
        expect_invalid("缺 items", payload={})
        expect_invalid("多余字段", payload={"items": [{}], "x": 1})
        expect_invalid("items 非数组", payload={"items": {}})
        expect_invalid("items 空数组", payload={"items": []})
        expect_invalid("items 超限", payload={
            "items": [{"manifest": manifest, "ndjson": ndjson_text}] * 101})
        st, raw = batch(payload={"items": [{"manifest": manifest,
                                            "ndjson": ndjson_text}]},
                        headers={"X-Tenant-ID": ""})
        r = json.loads(raw.decode())
        check("显式空租户头 400 且仅非空 error",
              st == 400 and list(r.keys()) == ["error"] and r["error"])

        # ---- 合法批次：逐项不短路、等长同序 ----
        bad_struct1 = {"manifest": manifest}  # 缺 ndjson
        bad_struct2 = {"manifest": manifest, "ndjson": 1}  # ndjson 非字符串
        bad_struct3 = {"manifest": "x", "ndjson": ndjson_text}
        bad_struct4 = "not-an-object"
        tampered = dict(manifest, digest="0" * 64)
        bad_sig = dict(manifest, signature=manifest["signature"][:-2] + "AA")
        unknown_signer = dict(manifest, signer_did="did:web:nobody")
        bad_count = dict(manifest, count=manifest["count"] + 1)

        items = [
            {"manifest": manifest, "ndjson": ndjson_text},      # valid
            bad_struct1, bad_struct2, bad_struct3, bad_struct4,  # 清单非法
            {"manifest": tampered, "ndjson": ndjson_text},      # 签名校验失败
            {"manifest": bad_sig, "ndjson": ndjson_text},       # 签名格式错误
            {"manifest": unknown_signer, "ndjson": ndjson_text},  # 锚点不可用
            {"manifest": bad_count, "ndjson": ndjson_text},     # 签名校验失败(签名覆盖count)
            {"manifest": manifest, "ndjson": ndjson_text + " "},  # 导出内容不匹配
        ]
        st, raw = batch({"items": items})
        r = json.loads(raw.decode())
        check("合法批次 200 仅含 results", st == 200 and list(r.keys()) == ["results"])
        res = r["results"]
        check("等长", len(res) == len(items))
        check("第1项 valid", res[0] == {"valid": True})
        for i in (1, 2, 3, 4):
            check(f"第{i+1}项 清单非法",
                  res[i] == {"valid": False, "reason": "清单非法"}
                  and list(res[i].keys()) == ["valid", "reason"])
        check("篡改 digest -> 签名校验失败",
              res[5] == {"valid": False, "reason": "签名校验失败"})
        check("坏签名 -> 签名格式错误",
              res[6] == {"valid": False, "reason": "签名格式错误"})
        check("未知签名者 -> 锚点不可用",
              res[7] == {"valid": False, "reason": "锚点不可用"})
        check("篡改 count -> 签名校验失败",
              res[8] == {"valid": False, "reason": "签名校验失败"})
        check("ndjson 篡改 -> 导出内容不匹配",
              res[9] == {"valid": False, "reason": "导出内容不匹配"})

        st, raw = batch({"items": [{"manifest": manifest,
                                    "ndjson": ndjson_text}]}, headers=TB)
        r = json.loads(raw.decode())
        check("租户隔离 -> 锚点不可用",

                  {"valid": False, "reason": "锚点不可用"}])

        st, raw = _http("POST", f"{base}{BASE_PATH}/manifest/verify",

        check("ndjson 篡改 -> 导出内容不匹配",
              res[9] == {"valid": False, "reason": "导出内容不匹配"})

        # 租户隔离：他租户 -> 锚点不可用
        st, raw = batch({"items": [{"manifest": manifest,
                                    "ndjson": ndjson_text}]}, headers=TB)
        r = json.loads(raw.decode())
        check("租户隔离 -> 锚点不可用",
              st == 200 and r["results"] == [
                  {"valid": False, "reason": "锚点不可用"}])

        # 单项接口行为不变
        st, raw = _http("POST", f"{base}{BASE_PATH}/manifest/verify",
                        {"manifest": manifest, "ndjson": ndjson_text}, TA)
        check("单项 verify 仍 valid", json.loads(raw.decode()) == {"valid": True})

        first_results = res
    finally:
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait()

    # 重启后结论一致
    proc = start()
    try:
        st, raw = _http("POST", f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}{BATCH_PATH}",
                        {"items": items}, TA)
        r = json.loads(raw.decode())
        check("重启后同批次结论一致", st == 200 and r["results"] == first_results)
    finally:
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait()

    os.unlink(store)
    print()
    if failures:
        print("失败:", failures)
        sys.exit(1)
    print("全部通过")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
